name: Stickman / doodle explainer
what: Black-line stick figures, dot eyes, off-white paper, 1-2 accent colours, labels beside figures, slight line boil.
route: higgsfield-video-explainer skill (Gemini Omni 10-s blocks; run get_explainer_presets live, names change) -> Stickman preset (faceless or stickman mascot). High cut rate (1.5 s/image): Nano Banana stills + local editor Ken Burns (cheaper).
style_key: hand-drawn stick-figure doodle animation, thin uneven black marker lines on warm off-white paper, round heads with simple dot eyes and line mouths, no shading, no gradients, single accent colour #E63946 used only for emphasis objects, generous negative space, slight line boil, non-photorealistic, illustrated, not a photo, no live-action, no realism
pacing: explainer: 1 scene / 10 s; viral long-form: new image every 1.5-3 s; Shorts: cut every 1-2 s
music: often none, or soft lo-fi/plucky bed; whoosh/pop/scribble SFX per new element
consistency: mascot key with one distinguishing prop (glasses, tie colour, cap); repeat the identifier phrase every block
cost_tips: stills + local motion are ~10x cheaper than video blocks; reuse a 30-pose mascot library; draft 1 minute first
avoid: drift into realistic humans (style lock + realism negatives); garbled text (add text in the editor/cards); sameness = 'mass-produced' risk, so use original research + a recurring character

routes.free: Rive/Manim/HyperFrames rigs, or Nano Banana stills + editor Ken Burns + Kokoro VO
routes.cheap: Google Flow Veo 3.1 Lite (free 50 credits/day) on the stickman style key

name: Whiteboard / hand-drawn draw-on
what: Marker drawings appear stroke by stroke on a white board and accumulate; 1-2 accent colours.
route: Nano Banana final-state frames -> draw-on stroke-mask reveal in HyperFrames/Remotion (deterministic, cheap); or explainer skill custom key. Labels via cards engine.
style_key: whiteboard doodle illustration, confident black dry-erase marker linework on bright white board, occasional blue and red marker accents, flat, no shading, slight marker texture and streaks, drawings accumulate on the same board, clean composition with labelled-space left empty, non-photorealistic, illustrated, not a photo, no live-action, no realism, no on-screen text
pacing: new drawing every 3-6 s, draw speed synced to VO
music: light acoustic/ukulele bed; low marker squeak
consistency: one simple doodle character with the same described features every time
cost_tips: code-driven reveals = zero credits; generate only final frames
avoid: AI hand glitches (drop the hand); gibberish lettering; board 'resets' between clips (keep accumulation in the editor)

routes.free: Manim / HyperFrames stroke reveal of Nano Banana final frames

name: Flat vector motion explainer (Kurzgesagt-like, generic)
what: Flat geometric shapes on a saturated dark palette, soft glows, rounded cute creatures, constant gentle looping motion.
route: higgsfield-video-explainer skill (Gemini Omni 10-s blocks; run get_explainer_presets live, names change) -> 'Pastel Flat 2D' or custom flat key (Nano Banana); precise loops/data in HyperFrames/Remotion with vectorised GPT Image assets.
style_key: flat 2D vector motion-graphics illustration, clean geometric shapes, no outlines, soft inner glows and subtle radial gradients, deep navy #1B1F3B background with saturated teal, coral, gold accents, rounded friendly creature designs with simple dot eyes, crisp edges, calm cosmic lighting, non-photorealistic, illustrated, not a photo, no live-action, no realism, no on-screen text
pacing: 1 composition per 4-8 s with secondary motion
consistency: species mascot with fixed hex colours in the key
cost_tips: generate an asset sheet once, animate in code
avoid: cheap clone look (use your own palette + mascot, never their characters); banding; over-busy frames

routes.free: Rive/Lottie + HyperFrames (vector assets from GPT Image/Nano Banana)

name: 2D anime / hand-painted (generic)
what: Cel-shaded characters, painterly gouache backgrounds, big skies, warm nostalgic light. Never name a studio, film or character.
route: Character sheet (Nano Banana turnaround) -> key frames -> Seedance 2.5 / Kling I2V; explainer skill (Watercolor Chronicle or custom) for narrated pieces.
style_key: hand-drawn 2D anime cel animation, clean thin lineart, two-tone cel shading on characters, lush hand-painted gouache backgrounds, towering cumulus clouds, warm golden-hour light, soft film grain, nostalgic slice-of-life mood, original character designs, non-photorealistic, illustrated, not a photo, no live-action, no realism, no text, no logos
music: piano/strings or lo-fi; wind, cicadas, train ambience
consistency: sheet (front/3-4/side) on every generation; hair silhouette + outfit colour lock; Kling Elements or Seedance omni_reference
avoid: IP mimicry; lineart flicker; off-model faces

routes.free: Nano Banana stills -> Wan 2.2 image-to-video locally (Apache-2.0)

name: 3D feature-animation cartoon (generic)
what: Stylised 3D, soft subsurface skin, big eyes, appealing shapes, warm cinematic light. See animation-3d-cartoon.md.
route: Nano Banana 2 character sheet -> Seedance 2.5 omni_reference (Kling for motion-control acting); generate_3d / scene builder for body interiors.
style_key: stylised 3D feature-animation render, soft subsurface skin, slightly oversized heads and eyes, rounded appealing shapes, warm key light with soft rim light, shallow depth of field, rich saturated but gentle colour, polished CG finish, original characters, no text, no logos
pacing: Shorts: cut every 1-2.5 s, visual gag in the first 1 s
voice: dry curiosity narrator or character VO
consistency: sheet + Element; four-part prompt (subject + details + action + key)
avoid: uncanny skin; IP lookalikes; gross-out body content; SG health anatomical scare tactics
formats: what happens to your body if

routes.cheap: Google Flow (50 credits/day) -> AI Pro for 1080p

name: Claymation / stop-motion look
what: Plasticine figures with fingerprints, felt/cardboard miniature set, stepped motion on twos, tilt-shift light.
route: Clay character + set key (Nano Banana) -> Seedance/Kling I2V ('stop-motion animation on twos') -> decimate to 12 fps locally in ffmpeg.
style_key: handmade claymation stop-motion, plasticine characters with visible fingerprints and slight surface imperfections, felt and cardboard miniature set, soft warm practical lighting, shallow tilt-shift depth of field, tactile matte textures, non-photorealistic, handcrafted, not a photo of real people
voice: playful persona VO (never a cloned celebrity)
consistency: clay simplifies faces; lock colours and props
cost_tips: generate at 24 fps, drop to 12 fps locally
avoid: too-smooth motion (reads CG); melting faces in fast action

routes.free: stills + Wan 2.2, decimated to 12 fps in the editor

name: Paper collage / editorial mixed media (Vox-like)
what: Torn paper, tape, halftone, newsprint, cut-out archival photos, highlighter and red-circle annotations, stop-motion jitter.
route: Higgsfield /vox-mixed-media ('Editorial Motion Graphics' explainer preset); real documents/charts composited in HyperFrames/Remotion (never generate documents).
style_key: editorial paper-collage animation, hand-cut paper shapes with torn white edges, visible tape strips, halftone dot textures, aged newsprint and kraft paper, bold flat red, cream and black palette, cut-out archival-photo style elements with white borders, highlighter and red-marker annotations, slight stop-motion jitter, non-photorealistic, illustrated, no legible text, no logos
pacing: new layer/annotation every 1-2 s; scene change every 5-8 s
music: minimal synth pulse; paper rustle, tape rip, marker squeak
consistency: no characters; one recurring motif (red string, pin)
cost_tips: code-animate real assets; generate textures only
avoid: AI-generated 'documents' = fabricated evidence (hard no); unreadable text; copyrighted photos

routes.premium: Nano Banana collage key -> Kling, or /vox-mixed-media

name: Motion typography / kinetic text
what: Words are the visuals: bold type animated to VO and beat, keyword highlights, icons, solid/gradient or blurred B-roll background.
route: Local editor caption presets / cards engine boards (tools/editor), or HyperFrames/Remotion template. Explainer skill explicitly excludes this. Zero generation credits.
style_key: DESIGN TOKENS (not a prompt): brand font pair, 2 brand colours + highlight, expo-out ~250 ms easing, 3-5 words on screen max, keyword highlight box, 9:16 UI safe zones
pacing: word-group change every 0.4-1.2 s, synced to syllables/beats
voice: punchy original VO or Klaus's real voice; text + music also works
avoid: text in UI zones; too many words; off-beat timing

routes.free: cards engine boards / HyperFrames (free is best)

name: Infographic / data-viz animation
what: Animated charts, counters, maps, timelines, icon arrays in brand palette, clean type, source line on screen.
route: Cards engine chart/stat boards (tools/editor cards.py) or HyperFrames/Remotion; dataviz skill rules. Never generate numbers with image/video models.
style_key: DESIGN TOKENS: validated palette, grid, type scale; bars grow from baseline ~600 ms, counters ease out, one idea per screen, 10 pt source line
pacing: one data point per 3-5 s; hold the key number >= 1.5 s
avoid: invented/unsourced stats (hard rule); truncated axes; hidden superlatives ('#1')

routes.free: cards engine chart/stat boards / HyperFrames / Manim (sourced stats only)

name: 2.5D parallax photo documentary
what: Real stills split into depth layers with a slow dolly, grain, dust, vignette.
route: Real photos (rights) -> optional upscale_image -> depth map -> DepthFlow locally (free) or Seedance/Kling camera-only I2V -> grain, VO, score. Label any AI recreation.
style_key: archival documentary photograph, period-accurate black-and-white silver-gelatin look, film grain, soft vignette, subtle dust and scratches, natural available light (gap-fill plates only); motion: slow 2.5D parallax dolly-in, foreground separates from background, no subject movement, no morphing
voice: documentary narrator or Klaus first person
consistency: real photos; generated people only as labelled recreations
cost_tips: DepthFlow = zero credits; AI only for hero shots
avoid: face warping (camera-only prompts); fake 'archival' passed as real; edge stretch

name: Isometric diorama / toy-brick world (generic)
what: Tiny world on a floating base, isometric camera, tilt-shift, cute miniature detail; or generic toy bricks (never LEGO marks).
route: Diorama key (Nano Banana) -> Seedance/Kling orbit, or Higgsfield 3D scene builder / generate_3d for consistent angles.
style_key: isometric 3D miniature diorama on a floating square base, orthographic camera at 30 degrees, tilt-shift shallow depth of field, soft global illumination, matte clay-plastic materials, cute simplified props and tiny people, pastel brand palette, clean background, no text, no logos
consistency: lock colours; 3D scene builder for angles
cost_tips: one key, many camera moves; GLB renders angles cheaply
avoid: trademark lookalikes; melting geometry; isometric drifting to perspective
formats: your business as a tiny agent factory

routes.premium: Nano Banana diorama key -> Seedance / 3D scene builder

name: Faceless photoreal AI documentary
what: Cinematic photoreal B-roll (landscapes, hands, silhouettes), anamorphic grade, documentary VO; faces mostly unseen.
route: documentary-3d.md + realism.md: keyframes (Nano Banana/GPT Image) -> Seedance 2.5 omni_reference 480p -> approve -> 1080p -> 4K upscale. Explainer skill cannot (non-photoreal only).
style_key: cinematic documentary realism, ARRI Alexa look, 35mm anamorphic lens, natural motivated lighting, muted teal-and-amber grade, fine film grain, shallow depth of field, handheld micro-movement, real-world textures and imperfections, faces mostly unseen or in silhouette, no text, no logos
pacing: 3-5 s shots; one 6-8 s establishing shot per scene
voice: deep documentary persona (voice-persona-audio.md; never a cloned narrator)
consistency: Soul/Element or avoid faces; same wardrobe token
cost_tips: most expensive: animatic from stills first; parallax stills for ~50% of shots
avoid: uncanny faces/hands; fabricated 'real' events; missing AI labels; never photoreal fake patients for health
